lines.service: MRI of the left knee without contrast - 73721

remarks: CO-50: Reason for denial: The MRI of the left knee without contrast is not medically necessary. Our clinical guideline BRI-CAR-394 requires documentation of conservative treatment before this service, and the records submitted do not show it.
appeal: This is not a bill. You or your authorized representative may file a written appeal within 180 days of the date you receive this notice. Send it to Brightmoor Benefit Solutions, Appeals Unit, PO Box 14448, Austin, TX 78701. If waiting for a standard decision could seriously harm your health, you may ask for an expedited appeal by calling 1-800-555-1491.
